name: Do No Harm
source:
After saving a mafia boss's brother, you’re pulled into his dangerous world, torn between your medical oath and a loyalty that could prove deadly. 

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Do_No_Harm]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
拯救黑手党老大的兄弟后，你被拉入他的危险世界，在你的医疗誓言和可能致命的忠诚之间左右为难。

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Do_No_Harm]Choices Wikia[/url]]
